text:
noelle: Heads-up 10min sync on tiny docs alignment items: voice/tone bullets + naming collisions. Found some mixed terms across guides (route vs endpoint, modelVariantId vs model_variant_id). Can we decide a single surface today? cc @jamie @rachel

jamie: Quick preference: public docs use snake_case for config keys (model_variant_id) but SDK examples should show idiomatic casing per language (modelVariantId in JS). Keep a note in style guide.

rachel: Agree. Also let's standardize wording around "latency SLO" vs "latency SLA". Proposal: use "latency SLO" in technical docs and "latency SLA" only where legal/contractual is implied.

noelle: Good call. I'll add that line to the docs style checklist.

tom: Found three examples where we use "route" to mean API path and another place where it's a console route. Suggest: use "API endpoint" for REST/HTTP and "console route" for Console UI paths.

jamie: :+1: I'll update the small glossary entry for "endpoint / route" to disambiguate and add redirect notes.

docs-bot: lint: docs build warning in migrate/migrate-guide.md: inconsistent param name detected (modelVariantId vs model_variant_id) at line 72

noelle: I'm going to batch fixes into PRs: #472 (style-guide updates), #473 (examples casing fixes), #474 (glossary disambiguation). Can reviewers please mark if you take any?

rachel: I'll take #474 and do the glossary writeup. Will include examples for both SDKs and a short note: "Use snake_case in YAML/configs, follow language conventions in SDK code."

jamie: Taking #473. I'll grep for modelVariantId, model_variant_id, modelId, model_id and open tiny PRs for each hit.

tom: I'll pick #472 and add the SLO/SLA line + brief voice guidance: "concise, explicit, avoid marketing adjectives like 'magical' or 'seamless' in API docs".

noelle: Also flagging a tiny migration snippet mismatch: curl example uses --data 'model=gpt-3' but SDKs expect model_id now. I'll update both the curl and the migration guide.

noelle: Old curl:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -d 'model=gpt-3&input=Hello'

noelle: New curl suggestion:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\ 
  -d '{"model_id":"gpt-3","input":"Hello"}'

jamie: Nice. Add a short note in the migration guide: "If you rely on model aliases, prefer model_id and include alias mapping snippet."

rachel: I'll add an alias mapping example in the glossary entry too.

docs-bot: CI: docs preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood/branches/473 (checks passed) 

noelle: Plan: canary deploy docs on Wednesday 09:00 UTC if all PRs merged. If you can't review, drop comments on the PRs. Try to avoid churn in snippets after canary.

tom: I'll do a final pass on Wednesday morning for voice consistency.

jamie: If anyone hits more inconsistent casing, ping me in the PR comments.

rachel: Will add the SLO->SLA guidance to the glossary and link it in the migration guide.

noelle: Thanks team 100! Small, focused changes should be quick. Ping here when each PR is ready to review. :rocket:
